Method of Attack: SMB worm spreading ransomware to random computers with exposed SMB port (port 445)
Use of ETERNALBLUE exploit to spread
Ping to kill-switch domain iuqerfsodp9ifjaposdfjhgosurijfaewrwergwea.com to control encryption start
Impacted Systems: Windows computers with exposed SMB port (port 445)
Old Windows operating systems including Windows XP, Windows 8, Windows Server 2003
Vulnerable home routers (by analogy to IoT malware infection speed)
Attack Vector: Exploitation of SMB vulnerability patched by Microsoft bulletin MS17-010
Use of leaked NSA ETERNALBLUE exploit
Email spam and malware droppers in earlier campaigns
Hosting payloads on Dropbox in some incidents
Indicators of Compromise: Bitcoin addresses used for ransom payments (3 addresses holding 17.309 Bitcoin)
